officialText:
Section 620.42 – Revise Section 620.42 to read as follows:

620.42 Hazardous (Classified) Locations. In hazardous (classified) locations, traveling cables shall be of a type approved for hazardous (classified) locations as permitted in 501.10(B)(2)(7), 502.10(A)(2)(6), 503.10(A)(3)(6), 505.15(C)(2), and 506.15(A)(6).
